steps.text: Open Willy Maker and start a new game
steps.why: Game Spec v1 is built from "New game", the way any user starts.

steps.text: Keep the CPS-1 board with the slammast layout (4 players × 3 buttons)
steps.why: The spec's set is slammast: B1 jump, B2 fire, B3 special.
The spec's level is small (4 screens × 2) and its own; the Buenos Aires template is the whole mission.
The wizard's second step.

steps.text: Type the game's title: Willy Gorklingo
steps.why: The title screen shows it (WILLY GORKLINGO, the board's font is uppercase).
Recorded with the project.
The spec: P1 Willy and P2 a recruit play at once.
Its name and size come next.
Mission 1, section 1: the Puerto Madero docks.
The spec's level is 1536 px wide.
The spec's level is 448 px tall, for the upper dock.
Willy Maker makes the level with its dock floor, the two players' starts and an exit.

steps.text: Zoom out to see the whole level
steps.why: The 1536 × 448 level fits the canvas at about 80 %.

steps.text: Center the view on the level with the map strip
steps.why: So every cell of the level is on the canvas.
The spec's night palette and dark sky go on the far layer (scroll3, 32 px tiles).
The far layer's tileset is the starter night sky.
A rectangle of tiles in one stroke.
Tile 1 of the night sky: the darkest sky at the top.

steps.text: Fill the far layer's rows 0-4 with it
steps.why: A banded night sky, like the prototype's.
Tile 3 of the night sky: a lighter band in the middle.

steps.text: Fill the far layer's rows 5-9 with it
steps.why: A banded night sky, like the prototype's.
Tile 5 of the night sky: the city glow near the horizon.

steps.text: Fill the far layer's rows 10-13 with it
steps.why: A banded night sky, like the prototype's.
The level's shape is painted as collision tags; the street art follows them (Auto art).
Solid, platform, ladder and crate.
Crates are placed with one click each.
32 px crates, climbed by pushing.

steps.text: Place a crate on the dock at x 160
steps.why: The first step of the stack: 32 px.

steps.text: Place a crate next to it at x 192
steps.why: The bottom of the 64 px stack.

steps.text: Stack a crate on top of it
steps.why: The stack is now 64 px: pushed up from the 32 px crate, then a jump.
Ledges, ladders and docks are rectangles of tags.
Stood on, jumped up through, and down + B1 drops through it.

steps.text: Draw the one-way ledge 64 px up, x 256-367
steps.why: Reached by a jump from the crate stack; down + B1 is its way down.
The way up to the upper dock.

steps.text: Draw the ladder at x 480, 160 px tall
steps.why: From the dock floor (y 416) up to the upper dock (y 256).
The upper dock is a solid floor.

steps.text: Draw the upper dock, x 496-1023 at y 256
steps.why: The second floor; its right end is open, so players drop back to the lower dock.
Enemies, civilians and the exit are placed by clicking.
The spec's enemy is the Trooper.
Each Trooper walks a 96 px patrol and turns at its ends.

steps.text: Place a Trooper at x 640, on the lower dock, under the upper dock
steps.why: The spec's three enemies: lower dock, upper dock, exit.

steps.text: Place a Trooper at x 800, on the upper dock
steps.why: The spec's three enemies: lower dock, upper dock, exit.

steps.text: Place a Trooper at x 1360, guarding the exit
steps.why: The spec's three enemies: lower dock, upper dock, exit.
Two civilians to rescue by touching them.
The first civilian waits on the one-way ledge.

steps.text: Place her on the ledge at x 320
steps.why: Rescued after the jump from the crates.
The second civilian waits on the upper dock.

steps.text: Place the child on the upper dock at x 960
steps.why: Past the upper dock's Trooper.
Starts, checkpoints, camera locks and the exit.
The spec's exit is at x 1440-1504 on the lower dock.

steps.text: Place the exit at x 1440 on the lower dock
steps.why: A new exit replaces the one the template made at x 1488.

steps.text: Make the exit 64 px wide in the inspector
steps.why: x 1440 to 1504, as the spec says.
Willy Maker shades what players cannot get to; nothing should be left out.
The level reads better without the shading.
The spec's rules are set in the Rules card.
The spec: a Trooper takes 3 shots.
The spec: each Trooper gives 100 points.
The spec: each civilian gives 500 points.
The spec: they hurt a player on touch.
The spec's Troopers walk their patrol and turn at its ends.
The spec gives them touch damage only.

steps.text: The exit needs every enemy down: Yes
steps.why: The spec: reaching the exit with all enemies down shows SECTION CLEAR.
steps.selector: radiogroup "The exit needs every enemy down" > radio "Yes"

steps.text: After a hit: blink in place
steps.why: The spec: the player blinks and loses 1 of 3 energy.
steps.selector: radiogroup "After a hit" > radio "Blink in place"

steps.why: The spec: the player blinks 1 s.
The spec: 1 of 3 energy per hit.
Willy Maker runs the level in the browser with the same rules the ROM gets.

steps.text: Walk right toward the crates (arrow key)
steps.why: A quick feel of the start before making the ROM.
The texts are next.
The title screen and the clear text come from here.
The spec's title screen.
The spec's second line.

steps.text: Check the prompt says PUSH START
steps.why: The spec's prompt; the credits line (C) 2026 GO-LINK is on by default.
Its Level clear text is what the section shows at the exit.
The spec's text at the exit.

steps.text: Look at the Game over screen
steps.why: GAME OVER shows when every player is out of energy and there is no credit.
The review, then Create ROM.
Stage 2: the game is packed as data next to the prebuilt engine, as slammast's files, then powered on in the board model.

steps.text: Read the result: every power-on step and the picture
steps.why: Validation level 3 ran by itself on the new ROM.
slammast.zip: the set the mame2003-plus core and a go-link room run.
symbols.json: where the game keeps its state, for the experiment's harness.
It sends the ROM to the linked go-link; this recording has no device linked, so it says how to link one.

steps.text: Done: the level is built, the ROM created, powered on and downloaded
steps.why: Next: the harness checks this exact zip (levels 3 and 4, the clear script, the real core).
